theory.md: Длинное действие — Past Continuous, короткое, которое его прервало, — Past Simple. **While** — «пока шло» (обычно с длинным), **when** — «когда случилось» (обычно с коротким).

cells: I was walking home when it started to rain.
While I was walking home, I met Bert.
When he saw me, he smiled.

theory.md: Если части меняются местами, после первой ставят запятую: **When** the phone rang**,** I was cooking.

examples.es: I was having a shower when the phone rang.
examples.ru: Я был в душе, когда зазвонил телефон.

examples.es: While we were eating, the lights went out.
When she saw the lighthouse, she stopped.
He broke his leg while he was skiing.
examples.ru: Он сломал ногу, катаясь на лыжах.

options: I was sleeping when you called.
I slept when you were calling.
I was sleeping while you called.
exercises.explain: Длинное — Continuous, короткое — Simple, связь when.

exercises.prompt: Что лучше подходит: «___ I was cooking, the cat ate the fish.»

exercises.sentence: I ___ along the beach when I found a bottle.
exercises.ru: Я шёл по пляжу, когда нашёл бутылку.

exercises.sentence: While they were talking, somebody ___ the door.
exercises.ru: Пока они разговаривали, кто-то постучал в дверь.

exercises.explain: during + существительное (during the night), с действием — while.

exercises.statement: «When I arrived, they were having dinner.» — правильно.

exercises.answer: While I was waiting, it started to rain.

exercises.sentence: She ___ (read) when the lights went out.
